description: This file defines the IncrementalCache class used for managing server-side caching and revalidation of page data in a Next.js application, including methods for retrieving, setting, and managing cache entries, as well as handling prerender manifest data.

classes.name: IncrementalCache
classes.description: A class for managing incremental caching of page data, including methods for retrieving, setting, and invalidating cache entries, with support for prerender manifest integration and disk persistence.

methods.name: toRoute
methods.description: Converts a pathname to a route by removing trailing slashes and 'index' suffixes.

methods.name: getSeedPath
methods.description: Constructs the file path for cached seed files based on page pathname and extension.

methods.name: calculateRevalidate
methods.description: Calculates the revalidation timestamp for a given pathname based on the prerender manifest or development mode.

methods.name: getFallback
methods.description: Reads the HTML fallback file for a given page.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves cache data for a given pathname, checking disk if not in memory, and marks data as stale if revalidation time has passed.

methods.name: set
methods.description: Stores cache data for a given pathname, optionally updating the prerender manifest and writing to disk.
